questions.concept: Enclosing mutation rollback restores component quota
questions.question: What happens to the three non-empty sends?

options.text: Only the first succeeds; the empty-body failure already used one token.
options.rationale: Would require component quota to commit separately from the failed root mutation.

options.text: The first two succeed; the third throws the structured rate-limit error.
options.rationale: The empty-body exception rolls back the consumed token; the two later successes exhaust the quota.

options.text: All three succeed; throwing after consumption resets the window on later calls.
options.rationale: Rollback restores prior state; it does not disable subsequent committed consumption.

options.text: None succeeds; the empty-body failure leaves the limit in a rejected state.
options.rationale: A failed mutation does not persist a poisoned limiter state.

questions.question: Which code belongs before the insert?
